author: PokerFace
body:
Hello everyone, I've been thinking of trying to add a new sub-gamemode to Avicus. With some inspiration off of Mineplex's "Bomb Lobbers" game, I think I've whipped up a map that will allow you to play this sub-gamemode. I present to you Bombastic!

*If the sub-gamemode ever becomes implemented, please call it Bombastic.


How it works:

Basically, this sub-gamemode is going to have 2 teams separated by some void/water. You will not be able to modify the map in any ways and, there are no bridges to the other side. The only way you can get kills is with your trusty bow. Now you may be thinking, " How am I supposed to shoot people from 50 blocks away?" These bows are special and will instead shoot some TNT. The TNT will not cause environmental damage however, depending on the map and further development, environmental damage may be added to the future.

Also, you have unlimited lives and because shooting TNT with a bow isn't exactly fun for 10 minutes, I've decided to let the map run for only 5 minutes. 

Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/5uXV0
YML: You would think i would know how to make one after all this time. Unfortunately, I don't. I'll hit someone on skype.
Download: Coming Soon!

Now before you give feedback, I just want to say that yes, this map is very plain. There is reasoning behind this though. TNT can often get laggy, and it would be best if the map was as clean as possible to reduce the lag you will recieve. Hopefully the gameplay can make up for it though. Thanks for looking! Any feedback is appreciated.
